impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>, kind: Kind) {
        if let Ok(record) = match kind {
            Kind::A => &mut self.left_consumer_for_the_lane,
            Kind::B => &mut self.right_consumer_for_the_lane,
        }
        .try_pop()
        {
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
